title: Malicious SHA-256 file hash b5149190ab5c… (OffSeq Mirage)
description: A malicious file identified by the SHA-256 hash b5149190ab5cdfcee95c4aa201bdd0229f426d3bbf6d2cd45d0e983f120b94b7 was observed by OffSeq Mirage honeypot sensors on 2026-10-24. This file was seen 9 times in attacker activity involving the T1105 technique (Ingress Tool Transfer), indicating it was used to stage or deliver a malicious payload such as a dropper, web shell, miner, or post-exploitation tool. No specific software versions or products are affected, and no known exploits in the wild have been reported. The file hash serves as an indicator of compromise (IOC) for detection and response purposes.
